changelog:
Initial release of ad-creative skill.

- Generates, iterates, and scales ad creative—including headlines, primary text, and full ad variations—for all major paid advertising platforms.
- Supports four expert workflows: generate from scratch, iterate with performance data, batch static production with grounded source material, and advanced creative strategy loop.
- Enforces input grounding: every batch ad concept must be sourced from winning ads, real customer reviews, or live comments—never invented.
- Automatic platform spec enforcement: verifies all copy fits each platform’s headline, character, and format limits before delivery.
- Includes detailed onboarding: guides users to provide product, audience, and performance context before creative generation.
